source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Filtration, printed as a second 15.1 with Figures 15.1 to 15.4, pages 324-326.

blocks.text: Filtration do ajza wale heterogeneous mixture ke ek juz ko solution se alag karti hai. Pehle munasib solvent chuna jata hai jis mein ek juz poori tarah hal ho jabke doosra amalan na hale. Aam namak aur ret ke mixture ke liye, mixture distilled water mein hal kiya jata hai: namak poore pani mein phail kar homogeneous mixture deta hai, pani mein aam namak ka solution, jabke ret bina hale rehti aur beth jati hai. Namak solute aur pani solvent hai, solvent woh juz jo zyada miqdar mein hai. Phir filtration ret ko alag karti hai.

blocks.title: Solute, solvent, solution, filtrate aur residue
blocks.text: Solution mein hal shuda madda solute aur zyada miqdar wala liquid solvent hai. Filtration ke baad funnel ke neeche flask mein jama liquid filtrate hai, aur filter par bacha solid residue.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: conical flask ke oopar kaghaz ke cone wala funnel, jis par dala gaya mixture, kaghaz par residue aur neeche filtrate label shuda hain, saath filter media ki fehrist ke paas fluted kaghaz aur crucible ke khake. Oopar daen: crystallization ka usool, behtareen solvent ki khusoosiyat, aam solvents aur sukhane ke tareeqe. Neeche: saturate karne, garam filter karne, aahista thanda karne, crystals filter karne aur sukhane ke qadmon ke paanch dabbe.
blocks.caption: Filter paper aur crucibles se filtration, aur crystallization ke qadam (Figures 15.1 se 15.5 aur topics 15.1 se 15.4.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Namak se ret alag karne ke liye mixture pani mein hilaya jata hai, jo namak hal karta aur ret chhorta hai, aur suspension funnel mein kaghaz ke cone se guzari jati hai: ret residue ke taur par rukti hai aur saaf namak ka solution filtrate ke taur par guzarta hai. Fluted kaghaz ya suction wala crucible filtering tez karta hai, aur crucibles un precipitates ke liye bhi kaam aate hain jo jalane hon ya un solutions ke liye jo kaghaz par hamla karein. Crystallization solution se khalis solid wapas pati hai: use garam solvent mein hal kar ke jo thanda hone par kam rakhta hai, garam filter kar ke, aahista thanda kar ke taake darmiyane size ke crystals barhein, crystals ko suction se mother liquor se filter kar ke aur sukha kar, rangeen na-pakiyan hatane ko charcoal aur mehfooz sukhane ko desiccator ke saath.

blocks.text: Sheeshe ke funnel aur filter paper se filtration aam taur par sust hoti hai: jaise mixture dala jata hai, solvent guzar jata hai, muallaq zarraat kaghaz par chhorte hue. Filter papers mukhtalif porosities (soorakh ke size) mein milte hain, precipitate ke zarraat ke size ke mutabiq chune hue; kaghaz itna bara ho ke aakhir mein ek chauthai se aadha precipitate se bhara ho, taake filtrate chhitke baghair beaker ke kinare se utre (Figure 15.1). Kaghaz aadha, phir dobara aadha mora jata aur cone mein khola jata hai, 60-degree funnel mein rakha, pani se geela kar ke dabaya jata hai (Figure 15.2a). Conical funnel se filtration ki raftar fluted filter paper se bohat barhti hai, jo pankhe ki tarah bari bari ubhar aur gehrai ke saath mora jata hai (Figure 15.2b).

Precipitate crucible se suction ke zariye bhi filter kiya ja sakta hai. Gooch crucible porcelain ka hai jis ka soorakh-dar pendah kaghaz ke pulp ya size ke mutabiq kate filter paper se dhaka hota hai (Figure 15.3); suction apparatus mein rakh kar yeh jaldi filter karta hai, aur un precipitates ke liye mozoon hai jo zyada darja hararat par jalane hon; soorakh asbestos ki chatai se dhak kar yeh kaghaz se react karne wale solutions, jaise ghaliz HCl aur KMnO4, filter kar sakta hai. Sintered glass crucible mein pendah mein masamdar sheeshe ki disc jari hoti hai aur koi tayyari nahi chahiye (Figure 15.4).

blocks.prompt: Istemal hone wale filter media batayein, gravity filtration ko vacuum filtration se, aur Gooch ko sintered glass crucible se alag karein (Quick Check 15.1a, c, d; exercise Q.2c).
blocks.explanation: Media: saada aur fluted filter paper, kaghaz ke pulp ya asbestos wala Gooch crucible, aur sintered glass crucible. Gravity filtration liquid ko apne wazan se kaghaz ke cone se guzarne deti hai aur sust hai; vacuum filtration use suction se crucible se kheenchti hai aur tez hai. Gooch crucible porcelain ka hai jis ke soorakh istemal se pehle pulp ya asbestos se dhakne parte hain, aur ise jalaya ja sakta hai; sintered glass crucible mein bani-banai masamdar sheeshe ki disc hai, tayyari nahi chahiye, magar ise zor se garam nahi kiya ja sakta.

items: Filtration: halne wala juz (solute) solvent mein hal karein, filter se guzarein; na-halne wala residue rukta hai, filtrate guzarta hai (ret se namak).
Media: 60-degree funnel mein kaghaz ka cone (sust), fluted kaghaz (tez), Gooch crucible (suction, jalana, HCl aur KMnO4 ke liye asbestos), sintered glass crucible (tayyari nahi).
